description: A Commercial Construction project for a three-story office building is open in ProjectLibre. The architect has issued a change order requiring a Security Systems installation phase that was overlooked in the original schedule. Add a new 'Security Systems' summary group to the project containing four work tasks in sequence: (1) 'Install security conduit and backboxes' — 10 working days, cannot start until 'Pull wire in conduit and set area transformers' (task 122) is complete; (2) 'Pull security and low-voltage cable' — 5 working days, must follow conduit installation; (3) 'Install security panels, cameras, and card readers' — 8 working days, must follow cable pulling; (4) 'Test and commission security system' — 3 working days, must follow panel installation and also cannot start until 'Install and terminate electrical devices' (task 123) is complete. Assign the 'Electric Contractor' resource to all four tasks. Position the new phase after the existing Electrical section. Save the project when done.

new_tasks.name: Install security panels, cameras, and card readers
